### Soulchill Aura { #awakening-soulchill-aura }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/yomi/soulchill_aura.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

The cold of the underworld surrounds the user, chilling the souls of every enemy nearby and slowing them. Enemies with a weaker soul than the user or low on health get frozen solid.

| --- | --- |
| Base damage | 6 HP |

### Soul Reap { #awakening-soul-reap }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/yomi/soul_reap.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user's soul dashes forward through every enemy in its way, cutting their souls and not their bodies. Armor does nothing against it and enemies with a cut soul have a lot less max health for a while.

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Base damage | 75 HP |
| Cooldown | 25 s (500 ticks) |
| Abort cooldown | 2 s (40 ticks) |

</div>


<!-- move awakenawakennomi:undying_soul -->

### Undying Soul { #awakening-undying-soul }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/yomi/undying_soul.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

When a hit would kill the user their soul keeps the skeleton together, they get back up with some health and can't be hurt for a moment. For a while after that every hit they land freezes the target.
